title: BarcodeMAE+: Rethinking Masked Pretraining and Global Representations for DNA Barcode Foundation Models
abstract: arXiv:2609.35877v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Many DNA foundation models are pretrained by masking parts of a sequence and asking the model to reconstruct them. Standard masked pretraining exposes the encoder to special [MASK] tokens that are absent at inference, creating a mismatch between training and downstream use. The role of an explicit global sequence representation such as a [CLS] token and how it should be trained also remain poorly understood for DNA barcodes. We introduce BarcodeMAE+ and study model architecture, global [CLS] representation, and auxiliary pretraining objectives across arthropod COI (BIOSCAN-5M) and fungal ITS (UNITE+INSD) barcodes. Across both barcode regions, the encoder-decoder MAE-LM architecture outperforms its matched encoder-only counterpart in nearly all evaluated configurations, supporting MAE-LM as an effective architectural design for DNA barcode foundation models. A trained global [CLS] representation provides substantial additional gains: on

translated_title: BarcodeMAE+：重新思考DNA条形码基础模型的掩码预训练与全局表示
translated_abstract: 许多DNA基础模型通过掩码序列的一部分并要求模型重建这些部分来进行预训练。标准的掩码预训练会使编码器接触到在推理阶段不存在的特殊[MASK]标记，从而造成训练与下游应用之间的不匹配。此外，对于DNA条形码而言，诸如[CLS]标记这样的显式全局序列表示的作用及其训练方式仍知之甚少。我们提出了BarcodeMAE+，并在节肢动物COI（BIOSCAN-5M）和真菌ITS（UNITE+INSD）条形码上系统研究了模型架构、全局[CLS]表示以及辅助预训练目标。在两个条形码区域中，编码器-解码器MAE-LM架构在几乎所有评估配置下都优于其对应的仅编码器架构，支持将MAE-LM作为DNA条形码基础模型的有效架构设计。经过训练的全局[CLS]表示还带来了显著的额外增益：（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: BarcodeMAE+通过系统研究模型架构与全局[CLS]表示的训练，证明编码器-解码器MAE-LM架构结合经过训练的全局表示能显著提升DNA条形码基础模型的性能，同时解决了标准掩码预训练中训练与推理不匹配的问题。
